q: An Asian Foods item shows as not on set in the lookup. What do you do first?
options: Pull it and set it aside
Verify it: the lookup drops the last UPC digit
explain: The item lookup drops the last UPC digit, so valid items can look not on set. The test store found about six. Verify first.

q: What happens to out-of-date product found in the Asian set?
options: Throw it in the store's trash
Pull it, label it, box it, and give it to the store
Move it to the back of the set
explain: Pull anything expired, label it, box it properly, and give it to the store. The test pulled three banana boxes.

q: Which part of the Asian set has the heavy glass bottles and side-to-side movement?
options: The first two or three bays (sauces and liquids)
explain: The first two or three bays hold heavy glass bottles with private label expansion, and most of that product shifts side to side.

q: In Frozen Bread Dough, which two items swap places?
options: Kroger private label and Texas Toast
explain: Kroger private label and Texas Toast swap places, with Kroger taking the lead.

q: In Baked Bread, Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level.
explain: Wonder mainstream and bun items move to eye level in their sections.

q: Which Red Bull 8.4 oz singles stay in Energy Drinks?
explain: Every 8.4 oz single except Original and Sugar Free comes out, along with all 16 oz cans.

q: In Upper Respiratory, where does Allegra go?
options: It stays on the bottom shelf
Off the bottom shelf, trading places with Benadryl
explain: Allegra moves off the bottom shelf and trades places with Benadryl. Tags follow the product.

q: During the Salad Mix reset, what happens to the brand identifier cards on the pusher trays?
options: They stay in the old slot
They go to the store manager
explain: The cards move with their product. New or replacement cards from the Vestcom box or the store go in, trimmed to fit.

q: The Suja racks in Premium Juice come out during the reset.
explain: Do not remove the Suja racks.

q: When do the produce sets get done?
options: First thing, unless I've set another priority
explain: Produce sets get done first thing unless another priority has been set.

q: The Innovation Endcap isn't at its mapped location. What do you do?
explain: Let me know first, and I'll get the mapping corrected.

q: When do shifts and payroll need to be complete for billing?
explain: Shifts and payroll are complete by end of day Saturday, 11/7.

q: Select the stores whose Vestcom box is still in transit.
explain: Stores 23 and 31: the box is still in transit. Keep an eye on the tracking.

options: Blackout weeks with zero Kompass hours
explain: Both are blackout weeks. P11W4 comes back at about 13 hours with Fem Hygiene.
